chaines.r: No. Ulti is a player: it plays the IPTV subscription you add yourself. Ulti does not provide any channels or content. You must have your own sources, and the right to watch them.

appareils.q: Which devices does Ulti work on?
appareils.r: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV: iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 or later, Apple TV with tvOS 17 or later, and Macs with Apple silicon, which use the iPad app. Premium works on all your devices signed in with the same Apple Account.

installer.r: Download Ulti from the App Store on your iPhone, iPad or Mac, and from the App Store on your Apple TV. Once installed, the app is called “Ulti IPTV”.
installer.rBientot: Ulti is coming soon to the App Store, for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Once installed, the app is called “Ulti IPTV”.

ajouter.q: How do I add my IPTV subscription?
ajouter.r:
Open Account › Subscriptions › Add a subscription. The easiest way, on iPhone: “Paste the message you received” (see the next question).

You can also enter the server, username and password, or paste an M3U link. On Apple TV, the easiest way is to send the subscription from your iPhone (see “Apple TV” below).

formats.r:
Xtream Codes accounts (server, username and password) and M3U playlist links. For the TV guide, Ulti uses your provider's; you can also enter the address of an XMLTV guide (.xml or .xml.gz) in Account › TV Guide.

Not supported: subscriptions tied to a MAC address, and Stalker / Ministra portals.

replay.q: Does replay work with my subscription?
replay.r: Replay is part of Premium. It works with an Xtream Codes account, for channels where your provider offers catch-up. It isn't available for M3U playlists yet.

trier.q: My subscription has too many channels. How do I sort them?
trier.r: In Account › My Content, choose the countries, categories and channels to show. The rest of your subscription stays available, just hidden. Each profile has its own choices.

plusieurs.r: Yes, with Premium. In Account › Subscriptions, tap a subscription to use it. My Content, My List, resume points and reminders stay separate for each one.

qr.q: How do I get my subscription onto Apple TV?
qr.r:
Without typing anything with the remote: open Ulti on the Apple TV and a QR code appears. Scan it with your iPhone camera, tap the Ulti link, and the subscription arrives on its own, with your categories, favourites and appearance. If the Apple TV already has a subscription, the QR code is in Account › Subscriptions › Add a subscription.

Your iPhone and Apple TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. The transfer is encrypted and goes directly over your local network; the parental code is never sent. You can also enter the subscription with the remote.

qrBloque.q: The QR code doesn't work. What should I do?
qrBloque.r:
Check that the Apple TV is on, on the same Wi-Fi network as the iPhone, and showing the QR code screen. The subscription must first be added on the iPhone.

If the iPhone was denied local network access, allow it in Settings › Ulti IPTV › Local Network, then scan the QR code again. A QR code eventually expires: always scan the one on screen.

profils.r: Each profile has its own My Content, My List, resume points and reminders. Profiles are managed in Account › Profiles. The free version includes a Kids profile; extra adult profiles are part of Premium.

enfant.r:
A Kids profile sees no adult category or content, has no access to subscriptions and can't be left without the parental code. This 4-digit code is also asked to change profiles and, when a Kids profile exists, to open an adult profile (unless you turn this off for that profile).

The parental code stays on each device: it is never sent, neither through iCloud nor to the Apple TV.

codeOublie.r:
On iPhone or iPad, tap “Forgot parental code”, confirm it's you with Face ID or the device passcode, then create a new code. The device passcode must be turned on in Settings.

On Apple TV, scan the QR code on screen with your iPhone, turn on “Allow a new parental code”, then confirm with Face ID or the iPhone passcode.

gratuit.q: What does the free version include?
gratuit.r: Live TV, the TV guide and reminders, My Content, grouping of duplicate channels, pasting your provider's message, Picture in Picture, sending to Apple TV by QR code, a Kids profile with parental code, and the Black theme.

inclus.r:
Movies and series (catalogue, details with posters and summaries, playback, resume points, every version of a movie), multi-screen, replay, live pause, downloads on iPhone and iPad, iCloud sync, extra adult profiles and subscriptions, the “For you” and “Popular” rows, the Halo and Programme themes, and alternative icons.

In the free version, you can browse movies and series; playing them requires Premium.

soloFamille.q: Solo or Family: what's the difference?
soloFamille.r: Both plans give the same Premium. Solo is for you, on all your devices with the same Apple Account. Family can be shared with up to 6 people through [Apple's Family Sharing](apple-partage). Each plan is available monthly, yearly or for life: see [pricing](tarifs).

essai.q: Can I try Premium for free?
essai.r: Yes: the monthly and yearly subscriptions, Solo or Family, start with a 7-day free trial. The lifetime purchase has no trial. If you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, you won't be charged.

restaurer.q: How do I restore my purchases?
restaurer.r: Premium usually comes back on its own on a new device. If not, open Account › Premium and tap “Restore Purchases”: Ulti finds a purchase made with the same Apple Account, or through Family Sharing with the Family plan.

resilier.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
resilier.r:
Subscriptions are managed by Apple. In Ulti, open Account › Premium › “Manage my subscription”. Or, on iPhone or iPad: Settings › your name › Subscriptions, choose the Ulti subscription, then cancel it ([Apple help](apple-resilier)).

Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period to avoid renewal. Premium stays active until the end of the period you've already paid for.

vie.q: I bought lifetime Premium: does my subscription stop on its own?
vie.r: No: Apple doesn't cancel a subscription on its own. If you had a monthly or yearly subscription before buying lifetime access, remember to cancel it so you're no longer charged. Ulti reminds you in Account › Premium.

occupee.q: “Your previous stream is still open”: what should I do?
occupee.r:
Your subscription allows only one stream at a time, and your provider often takes 1 to 2 minutes to release the previous one, for example right after a movie or another channel. Ulti shows a countdown on the “Try Again” button: tap it once the countdown ends. If another device is already watching with the same subscription, stop playback on that device.

In multi-screen, “No free connection left” means all the connections of your subscriptions are already in use. With a single-connection subscription, a download pauses while you watch, then resumes on its own.

refusee.q: “Connection refused by the provider” or “This subscription has expired”
refusee.r: These messages come from your provider's server: expired subscription, changed login details, or something playing on another device. Check your login details in Account › Subscriptions, or contact your provider. Ulti can't change or renew your IPTV subscription.

serveur.r: Check your internet connection. If it works, your provider's server may be temporarily unavailable: try again a little later.

identifiants.r: Yes. They are kept in your device's Keychain and never go through an Ulti server. With iCloud sync (Premium), they are end-to-end encrypted in your own iCloud account.

donnees.r: No. No account to create, no advertising, no analytics. Everything is explained in [our privacy policy](privacy).

coller.q: How does “Paste the message you received” work?
coller.r:
Did your provider send your login details by text, WhatsApp or email? On iPhone, copy the whole message, then, in Account › Subscriptions › Add a subscription, tap “Paste the message you received”. Ulti finds the server, username and password, or the M3U link, and fills in the fields by itself. Check them, then tap “Continue”.

The message is read on the iPhone, never sent or saved. Nothing connects before “Continue”.

multi.r: Multi-screen is part of Premium: watch up to 4 live channels at once on Apple TV, iPad and Mac, and 2 on iPhone. The number of screens also depends on your IPTV subscription: each live channel uses one connection, and many subscriptions allow only one. If you have several subscriptions, their connections add up.

partage.q: How do I share Premium with my family?
partage.r: Choose the Family plan: it can be shared with up to 6 people through [Apple's Family Sharing](apple-partage). Each family member opens Ulti with their own Apple Account and gets Premium; if needed, they tap “Restore Purchases” in Account › Premium. The Solo plan can't be shared.

contact.texte: Write to us at [{contact}](contact). Tell us your device (iPhone, iPad, Mac or Apple TV) and, if possible, the message shown. Never send your login details or your subscription address.

bref.texte: Ulti does not collect any personal data. No account to create, no advertising, no ad tracking, no analytics. The app contains no statistics or crash-reporting tools from another company.

identifiants.texte: The server, username and password of your IPTV subscription are stored only on your device, in Apple's Keychain, and in your iCloud Keychain if you turn it on. They never go through an Ulti server: there isn't one.

ip.texte: As with any online service, your IPTV provider, TMDB and Apple receive your device's IP address when the app connects to them. Ulti keeps no record of it.

icloud.texte: With Premium, your profiles, subscriptions (login details included), My Content, My List, resume points, reminders, frequently watched channels and appearance settings can be synced across your devices. They are stored in the private part of your own iCloud account, end-to-end encrypted: the developer has no access to them. The parental code stays on each device.

appletv.texte: When you send your subscription from iPhone to Apple TV by QR code, the data goes directly from one device to the other over your local network, encrypted. Nothing goes through a server. The parental code is never sent.

message.texte: When you paste your provider's message, it is analysed on your device, never sent or saved.

fichiers.texte: Downloaded videos stay on your device. For live pause, Ulti keeps the last minutes of the channel on the device; nothing is kept after the player closes.

achats.texte: Purchases are handled by Apple, on the App Store. Ulti only keeps your Premium status on the device, so it works offline, and sends it nowhere.

plantages.texte: Ulti sends no reports itself. If you agreed, in your device settings, to share analytics with app developers, Apple may pass technical crash reports on to the developer. During TestFlight beta versions, feedback and reports you choose to send are passed on to the developer by Apple.

site.texte:
This website uses no trackers, no cookies and no analytics, and loads nothing from another site. Only the country you choose is kept in your browser (local storage), to bring you back to the right version; it is erased with your browsing data.

The website is hosted by GitHub Pages. Like any host, GitHub receives technical connection data, including the IP address, to serve the pages ([GitHub's privacy statement](github-confidentialite)).

droits.texte: As Ulti holds no data about you, there is nothing for us to access or delete. To erase everything from your devices, remove your subscriptions in Account › Subscriptions (which also erases them from iCloud), or delete the app.
